lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The centroids are most prominent in the mid-lateral zone, forming a grid-like distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Clearly defined vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the circular blobs, forming anchor nodes where the vertical stripes meet horizontal lines of spots.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (top) to shadow (bottom).

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae (remoras) attached to the cranial region, the leading edge of the pectoral fin, and swimming beneath the ventral surface.
